text.text_excerpt: Honestly, this hotel gets 4 stars because of its location...which is totally amazing!!! It's so close to everything...Bourbon St, a ton of amazing restaurants, Harrah's casino, sightseeing companies...anything you want to see and visit while here. Our room was cute but it did not have a dresser in it. So unfortunately, I couldn't unpack all my things and I had to use my suitcase as a dresser and it was a pain to keep it all organized. However, our friend's room did have a dresser. I guess it's the luck of the draw. The beds were very comfortable and we slept well for the four nights that we were there. The bathroom was quite small for the size of the room but it wasn't a problem. The staf...

Upon first arrival, it's a little hard to find this hotel. The hotel name and street number aren't particularly visible. But we ended up finding our way and were greeted immediately by a very friendly staff member who go us checked in right away and they even gifted us a mini king cake, since it was around Mardi Gras (which we did not know) Because of Mardi Gras being so close by and the hotel being an older French Quarter hotel, the walls were a little thin and we could hear quite a bit of the outside noise. But the beds were comfortable and there were plenty of pillows. Every morning there was fresh water and coffee in the lobby, which continued throughout the day, and every single staf...

Our family recently stayed at this hotel and we had an INCREDIBLE stay! The management was extremely kind and helpful and the hotel room was flawless. Another perk of this hotel was the location! A few blocks from Bourbon Street and about a half mile walk to French Market. If you're looking for a nice stay without the hustle and bustle, you may want to give this hotel a shot.
